strings.notes: US 0678/0; 顺也 = 0719 #579 Shane (US contact Biker Ernest)

strings.zh: 你的胆量可不小啊,{NEWLINE}我有点喜欢上你了！{CLEAR}和我做哥们吧！{SCROLL}我们交换一下电话号码,{NEWLINE}以后多多交流吧！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: You’ve got some guts! I’m kinda{NEWLINE}starting to like you! Let’s be bros!{SCROLL}Whadda ya say we trade phone numbers{NEWLINE}and keep in touch? {VAR:0200:0}
strings.notes: US 0678/1 | RV072: meaning: restored 'I like you'/bros; removed invented lines

strings.zh: 完成！{NEWLINE}以后有什么事就打电话吧！{SCROLL}比如学习上的,{NEWLINE}关于精灵或者{CLEAR}解谜什么的,{CLEAR}还有道馆的心得之类的,{CLEAR}反正你有了难处,{CLEAR}就和我聊聊吧！{SCROLL}虽然不知道能不能帮上忙,{NEWLINE}但我肯定会听你说的！{SCROLL}因为我们是哥们嘛！
strings.en: Done! Call me if anything comes up!{SCROLL}Studying, Pokémon, puzzles, Gym tricks,{NEWLINE}whatever.{SCROLL}Basically, whenever you’re in a jam,{NEWLINE}just talk to me!{SCROLL}I dunno if I’ll be any help, but I’ll{NEWLINE}definitely listen!{SCROLL}’Cause we’re bros, you know?
strings.notes: US 0678/2 | RV072: meaning: 有了难处 = when in trouble (was inverted)

strings.en: Hey, hey! What’s that{NEWLINE}supposed to mean?

strings.zh: 哈哈！你终于{NEWLINE}被我的魅力所折服了吗？{SCROLL}真拿你没办法,{NEWLINE}登录一下电话号码吧！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Ha ha! So you’ve finally been won over{NEWLINE}by my charm?{SCROLL}Guess I can’t say no to you. Let’s{NEWLINE}register your number! {VAR:0200:0}
strings.notes: US 0678/4 | RV072: meaning: 真拿你没办法 restored

strings.zh: 虽然我看上去{NEWLINE}确实有点可怕,{CLEAR}可我也有{CLEAR}温柔的一面。{SCROLL}放心,我不会吃了你的,{NEWLINE}直接和我见面吧！
strings.en: Well, I probably look a lot scarier than{NEWLINE}I really am. Would you believe I’m really{CLEAR}a nice guy?{SCROLL}I won’t bite, so come and talk to me{NEWLINE}in person!

strings.zh: 喂,泰迪！{NEWLINE}你模仿摩托的叫声{CLEAR}越来越像了啊！{SCROLL}下次,{NEWLINE}我们要一起骑车,{CLEAR}然后一起吼！{SCROLL}⋯⋯你是谁？{SCROLL}晕！打错了！{NEWLINE}不好意思！
strings.en: Yo, Teddy! You do a pretty good{NEWLINE}impression of a motorcycle!{SCROLL}Next time you get a chance, you and I{NEWLINE}should go riding and yell like{CLEAR}motorcycles. What do you say?{SCROLL}......Wait, who is this?{SCROLL}Oh no! Wrong number!{NEWLINE}Sorry!

strings.zh: 我的{VAR:0100:10}{NEWLINE}现在很努力！{CLEAR}因为它的气势别具一格！{SCROLL}除了很厉害的家伙,{NEWLINE}它是不可能输的！{SCROLL}你的精灵怎么样？{NEWLINE}很有干劲吗？{SCROLL}⋯⋯你不用说了,{SCROLL}因为你的实力{NEWLINE}我是见识过的！
strings.en: My {VAR:0100:10} does a great job!{NEWLINE}Anyway, its fighting spirit is different.{SCROLL}It’s never lost to any but the{NEWLINE}strongest Pokémon!{SCROLL}What about your Pokémon?{NEWLINE}Do they have any fighting spirit?{SCROLL}Never mind, you don’t have to answer.{SCROLL}I should know better than anyone just{NEWLINE}how strong your Pokémon are!

strings.zh: 我听说我们暴走族{NEWLINE}只能培养那种{CLEAR}身上有剧毒,{CLEAR}浑身长满了刺,{CLEAR}带有尖牙,{CLEAR}还要是鬼系的精灵。{CLEAR}总之越是可怕{CLEAR}越符合我们的身份。{SCROLL}不过⋯⋯{SCROLL}我还是喜欢⋯⋯{SCROLL}像玛力露那样的{NEWLINE}可爱精灵！！
strings.en: I heard us bikers are only supposed{NEWLINE}to raise Pokémon that are full of{CLEAR}poison, covered in spikes, got fangs,{CLEAR}or are Ghost types. Basically, the{CLEAR}scarier the better for our image.{SCROLL}But...{SCROLL}I still like...{SCROLL}cute Pokémon like Marill!!

strings.zh: 昨天{NEWLINE}我想去抓一只{VAR:0100:11},{CLEAR}可是{VAR:0100:11}一看到我的脸,{CLEAR}就吓的一溜烟跑掉了！{SCROLL}真是太没礼拜了！{SCROLL}你看到我,{NEWLINE}会不会也想跑？
strings.en: So, yesterday I thought I was gonna{NEWLINE}catch a {VAR:0100:11}.{CLEAR}But that {VAR:0100:11}, it took one look{CLEAR}at me and ran off!{SCROLL}It was totally rude!{SCROLL}You wouldn’t run away if you saw me,{NEWLINE}would you...?

strings.zh: 喂！我好想和你{NEWLINE}再对战一场啊,{CLEAR}我都已经忍不住了！{SCROLL}我还是在{NEWLINE}{VAR:0104:3}等你！{CLEAR}不要放我鸽子啊！
strings.en: Yo! I really wanna battle you again. I{NEWLINE}can’t hold back any longer!{SCROLL}I’ll be waiting on {VAR:0104:3}{NEWLINE}like always. Don’t stand me up!
strings.notes: US 0678/10 | RV072: meaning: 放我鸽子 = stand me up

strings.zh: 你怎么回事？{NEWLINE}我在{VAR:0104:3}等你啊。{SCROLL}你不会把{NEWLINE}哥们的约定⋯⋯都给忘了吧？
strings.en: What’s going on with you?{NEWLINE}I’m waiting on {VAR:0104:3}!{SCROLL}You wouldn’t forget a promise you made{NEWLINE}with a buddy, would you?

strings.zh: 玛奇上次跟我说,{NEWLINE}你要加入{CLEAR}我们了？{SCROLL}大家一起在{NEWLINE}自行车道上奔驰,{CLEAR}把垃圾扔一地,{CLEAR}然后把那些垃圾捡回去,{CLEAR}这种感觉真舒服！
strings.en: Maggie told me the other{NEWLINE}day you’re joining our crew?{SCROLL}We all tear down Cycling Road together,{NEWLINE}throw our trash all over the place,{CLEAR}then pick it all back up. Feels great!
strings.notes: US 0678/12; 玛奇 = US 'Markey' (vanilla biker reference); 0719 #577 玛奇 is Maggie, probably a different trainer | [D-1186 rename 2026-09-29: Markey → Maggie]
